ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.primaryHintBilling: Pays for this team and is the only one who can delete it.
ownership.primaryHintSelfHosted: The only one who can delete this team.
ownership.leaveBlocked: Make another Owner the primary owner before you leave this team.

confirmPrimary.title: Make {{name}} the primary owner?
confirmPrimary.bodyBilling: {{name}}'s own Teams or Business subscription pays for this team from now on, and only they can delete it. Your subscription stays as it is: lower your seats or cancel it yourself.
confirmPrimary.bodySelfHosted: Only {{name}} will be able to delete this team. You stay an Owner and can leave afterwards.

invite.title: Invite {{name}} as an Owner?
invite.body: Owners hold every permission, including adding and removing other Owners. The primary owner and billing stay as they are.

grant.title: Make {{name}} an Owner?
grant.body: Owners hold every permission, including adding and removing other Owners.

revoke.title: Remove Owner from {{name}}?
revoke.body: {{name}} keeps any other roles they hold.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.readOnlyNoManage: You need the Manage members permission
permissions.readOnlyOwner: An owner's permissions cannot be overridden
permissions.readOnlySelf: You cannot change your own permissions
permissions.readOnlyHigherRole: This member holds a role at or above yours
permissions.readOnlyNotHeld: You cannot grant a permission you do not hold

revokeKeyAccess.title: Revoke {{name}}'s access to the vault key?
revokeKeyAccess.body: {{name}} will no longer be able to connect or view secrets in this vault. They keep a copy of the current key and can still read secrets already synced to their device, so the vault key will be rotated for the remaining members.

convert.title: Share "{{vault}}" with other people?
convert.body: This turns your private vault into a team vault. Everything already in it moves across, so the people you add see it too.
convert.offlineWarning: Opens only while Voltius can reach the sync server — no offline access.
convert.keyCustody: Everyone you add gets a copy of its key. Removing them later doesn't take it back.
convert.change: You can make it private again later — that removes everyone's access, but not the copies they already have.

detail.nameHint: Leave empty to show their handle.

invite.ownerOnlyOwners: Only Owners can invite someone as Owner
invite.nameHint: Teammates see this instead of their handle. Only admins can change it.
invite.title: Invite member
invite.seatsScope: Counted across every team you own, not just this one.
invite.seatsTrialClamp: Your trial caps you at {{cap}} seats until it ends, of the {{purchased}} you bought.
invite.handleRule: Only custom handles match on part of a name. For a generated handle like rapid-violet-8884, type it in full or use their email.
invite.seatsUnknown: Seat count unavailable — check your connection to the sync server
invite.selectRoleHint: Select at least one role before inviting

roleBlurb.owner: Owners hold every permission, including adding and removing other Owners.
roleBlurb.manager: Managers can invite people, change roles and manage links.
roleBlurb.editor: Editors can add and change hosts, keys and snippets in this vault.
roleBlurb.member: Members can use everything in this vault but not change it.
roleBlurb.connect-only: Connect-only people can open connections but never see the credentials behind them.

toast.invitationEmailNotSent: Invitation saved, but the email to {{email}} could not be sent. They join the team when they sign up with this address.

error.cannotRemoveOwnerRole: Make another Owner the primary owner first
error.seatLimitReached: No seats left. Ask your server administrator to raise the seat limit.
error.convertFailed: Could not turn {{vault}} into a team vault — {{reason}}
error.serverUnreachable: the sync server could not be reached
error.undoRolesNotRestorable: Undo can't restore the exact roles of {{name}}. Invite them again and set their roles by hand.
error.memberHasNoPublicKey: They haven't published a key yet — ask them to sign in once.
error.notAKeyHolder: You don't hold this vault's key, so you can't grant it.

contextMenu.noInvitableSessions: No session can take this invite

empty.noVaultDesc: Select a vault in the sidebar to manage its members.
empty.signInToInvite: Sign in to invite teammates to this vault.

people.awaitingKey: Waiting for a key — they cannot open the vault yet
people.inviteLinkCopied: Invite link copied — it opens their invitation in Voltius.

cta.signInTitle: Sign in to use team features
cta.signInDesc: Members, invites, and shared vault access require a cloud account before you can upgrade or manage a team.
cta.signInBtn: Sign in or create cloud account →
cta.ownPlanTitle: Converting a vault into a team needs your own Teams plan
cta.upgradeDesc: Invite members, assign roles, and share credentials securely with your team.
cta.trialNote: Card required · no charge during the trial

joinLinks.explainer: Anyone with the link joins this vault in the role you pick. The link never carries the vault's key — that arrives separately, once someone who already has it is online.
joinLinks.shownOnce: A link is shown once, when you create it. Nothing can show it again.
joinLinks.secretNotRecoverable: Link no longer viewable — revoke it and make a new one.

error.revokedOrExpired: This link has been revoked or has expired.
error.exhausted: This link has been used up.
error.seatLimit: This team has no seat free. Ask whoever sent the link to add one.
error.noPublicKey: Your device hasn't published a key yet. Sign in once, then open the link again.

confirm.title: Join {{team}}?
confirm.body: This link adds you to {{team}} as {{role}}.
confirm.keyFollowsLater: You'll join straight away, but the vault stays locked until someone who already has its key is online.
confirm.failed: Couldn't join — the link may have been revoked.

enrollment.title: Device enrolment
enrollment.explainer: One company-wide token for deploying Voltius with Ansible or MDM. People who use it ask to join {{team}}.
enrollment.invalidDomain: {{domain}} is not a domain name, like example.com.
enrollment.noEmail: This server cannot send email, so an admin must approve each join.
enrollment.guardHint: Each join needs a matching email domain, an admin's approval, or both.
enrollment.copyNow: Copy it now; it is not shown again.
enrollment.expiredHint: Rotate to issue a working token.
enrollment.notShownAgain: The token is not shown again. Rotate to get a new one.
enrollment.rotateMessage: The current token stops working for new enrolments. Devices already enrolled with it keep getting the team's policy.
enrollment.revokeMessage: Devices can no longer enrol with it, and those enrolled with it stop getting the team's policy. People who already joined stay members.
enrollment.lapsed: Device enrolment needs the team's Business plan.

error.gone: This enrolment token was revoked or has expired.
error.needsGuard: Add an email domain or require approval.
error.needsApproval: This server cannot send email, so each join needs an admin's approval.
error.domainMismatch: Their email domain is not on the token's list.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to manage device enrolment.

enrollment.copyLinkTitle: Copy a link that opens Voltius on this enrolment

offboarding.pointAccessEnds: Their access to this vault's hosts, keys and snippets ends immediately, on every device.
offboarding.pointLocalWipe: The vault's contents are deleted from their devices, including saved passwords and private keys.
offboarding.pointAlreadySeen: They keep anything they already saw. Rotate credentials they had access to.
offboarding.pointSessions: They are dropped from any shared terminal session they had joined.
offboarding.leavePointAccessEnds: You lose access to this vault's hosts, keys and snippets on every device.
offboarding.leavePointLocalWipe: Its contents are deleted from this device, including saved passwords and private keys.
offboarding.leavePointIrreversible: You cannot rejoin without a new invitation.

security.title: Security policy
security.enforceDesc: Members can choose a shorter time, never a longer one.
security.forceVaultDesc: Members can't pick Lock screen, so locking always removes the vault key from memory.
security.immediateVaultWarning: With Immediately and Lock vault, members' open sessions close every time they leave Voltius, even briefly.
security.appliesToAll: Applies to every member, you included.
security.lockBody: Lock policies need the team's Business plan.
security.lapsed: Business plan lapsed: this policy stays enforced. You can remove it.

keyHealth.title: Vault key health
keyHealth.uncovered_one: {{count}} member is missing the current key.
keyHealth.uncovered_other: {{count}} members are missing the current key.
keyHealth.requested: A member left {{time}}, so a new key is due.
keyHealth.remaining_one: {{count}} item still uses an older key.
keyHealth.remaining_other: {{count}} items still use an older key.
keyHealth.remainingUnknown: Some items still use an older key.
keyHealth.blocked: No new key can be made until they are re-encrypted.

device.finished: This device finished its last try {{time}}.
device.skipped_one: {{count}} item needs someone who can edit it.
device.skipped_other: {{count}} items need someone who can edit them.

step.rotate: the server refused the new key.

keyHealth.loadFailed: Couldn't read the key status. Check your connection, then refresh.
keyHealth.retryDenied: Making a new key needs the View passwords and Copy passwords permissions.

stuck.title: Items on an older key
stuck.hidden_one: {{count}} more item is hidden from you. Someone who can see it needs to retry.
stuck.hidden_other: {{count}} more items are hidden from you. Someone who can see them needs to retry.

reason.orphan: Left over from a deleted item
reason.needsEditor: Needs someone who can edit it

keyHealth.removeBody: It can't be decrypted, so it stops this vault from getting a new key. Removing it deletes it for every member and can't be undone.
keyHealth.removeOrphanBody: It belongs to an item that no longer exists. Removing it lets this vault get a new key again.
keyHealth.note: A new key protects what is saved from now on. It can't take back anything a former member already copied.

devicePolicy.title: Device policy
devicePolicy.empty: Lock settings on every member's Voltius. Uses the same format as policy.json.
devicePolicy.olderVersions: Older Voltius versions only apply the app-lock settings.
devicePolicy.fixErrors_one: Fix {{count}} error in the file and import it again. Warnings do not block saving.
devicePolicy.fixErrors_other: Fix {{count}} errors in the file and import it again. Warnings do not block saving.
devicePolicy.replaces: Saving replaces the team policy on every member's Voltius.
devicePolicy.clearMessage: Every member's Voltius goes back to its own settings. This also removes the app-lock limits above.

issue.machineOnly: can only be set in machine policy
issue.defaults: Defaults belong in machine policy, not team policy
issue.unknownKey: is unknown to this version; newer apps may use it
issue.type: has a value this setting doesn't accept
issue.range: has a range this setting doesn't accept
issue.newerVersion: This file needs a newer version of Voltius
issue.file: This file isn't a valid policy.json
issue.plainTimeout: only applies on newer Voltius versions. Older ones need a maximum: {{example}}

joinRequests.title: Join requests
joinRequests.noSeatToast: No seat left. Add seats, then approve again.
joinRequests.emailUnverifiedToast: They still need to verify their email address. Approve again once they have.
